Name: Cuter Fatter Goats
Author: Identitypollution
Description:
At this time there is only adult goats with this mod because I honestly suck at downsizing/adjusting the art to be smaller, the baby goats are the original ones but color adjusted slightly to match the adults better. 

To Install:
1. OPTIONAL (but suggested just incase): Backup your baby goat.xnb and goat.xnb files located at Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
2. Download and extract download.
3. Put the new .xnb files where your old ones were (at the location above). Make sure to REPLACE the files or your game won't know what to use and won't start.
4. Done! Launch the game and enjoy~!

If anyone wants to make baby goats for these please feel free and if you would let me include it in this mod I would be very grateful and will be sure to credit you for your contribution!
